heading.purpose: Primary heading driver — page titles, section headings, nav. DM Sans Bold.

heading-secondary.purpose: Occasional accent voice only (DM Serif Display) — never the top-level heading.

mono.purpose: Numerals and tabular data — ownership %, week counts, prices, dates.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy Action fill, off-white text, 8px radius, 1pt inset border. The system's only confirmed button treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #113968; color: #F7FBFE; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18pt; font-weight: 700; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; border: 1px solid #113968; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(247,251,254,0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4C6A8E; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8AB9ED; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Circle
components.description: Circular icon container sharing the button's Navy Action fill and off-white icon color.
components.css: .ds-icon-circle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: #113968; color: #F7FBFE; }

components.name: Heading
components.description: Primary heading — DM Sans Bold, the system's main hierarchy driver.
components.css: .ds-heading { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: #1F3D59; margin: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Heading
components.description: Occasional accent heading voice — DM Serif Display. Never used as the top-level heading.
components.css: .ds-heading-secondary { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; color: #1F3D59; margin: 0; }

components.name: Mono Figure
components.description: Numerals and tabular data — ownership percentages, week counts, prices, dates.
components.css: .ds-mono { font-family: 'DM Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #36393E; }

narrative.overview: Heimkoma sells something precise and something scenic at once: a registered, countable ownership share (weeks, percentages, property counts) in a place defined by Iceland's coastline and light. The system should read like a well-kept ledger for a beautiful asset — exact where it counts (numerals, shares, dates set in mono type; sharp 8px corners; a thin, deliberate 1pt inset border on primary actions) and quietly scenic where it doesn't (navy grounding every surface like dusk water, sky-blue and sand as the only warmth, gold used as sparingly as a wax seal). Nothing about it should feel like a rental listing or a travel brochure — it should feel like the paperwork for owning something real, designed by people who also care about how the light hits a fjord. The primary heading voice is sans, not serif — DM Sans Bold carries the hierarchy. DM Serif Display exists only as a secondary, occasional accent, never as the system's main voice. This is a deliberate inversion of typical luxury-property design habits (serif-led hero type) and should be protected, not softened back toward convention.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-grounded, coastal-accented — sky blue and sand are the only permitted warmth beyond gold
Two distinct navies: navy (#1F3D59, palette/surface) and navy-action (#113968, buttons and icon-circles only) — related, never collapsed
Sans-led hierarchy: DM Sans Bold headings, DM Serif Display strictly secondary
Numerals and tabular data set in DM Sans Mono — the ledger detail
Gold is an accent color, never a primary button fill
Sharp, bordered, restrained — 8px button radius, 1pt inset borders, no confirmed shadow system

rules.name: The Two-Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy (#1F3D59) is the palette's surface color; Navy Action (#113968) exists only for buttons and icon-circle fills. Never use Navy Action for backgrounds or large surfaces, and never fill a button with plain palette Navy.

rules.name: The Gold Reserve Rule
rules.body: Gold (#FDB400) appears on accents, never as a primary button or CTA fill. Its rarity is what makes it read as premium rather than promotional.

rules.name: The Sans-Led Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Primary headings are always DM Sans Bold. DM Serif Display is a secondary, occasional voice — it never carries the top-level heading role, even at hero scale.

dos: Do use Navy (#1F3D59) for surfaces and grounding, and keep Navy Action (#113968) exclusive to buttons and icon-circle fills — two related but distinct tokens.
Do set primary headings in DM Sans Bold; use DM Serif Display only as a secondary, occasional accent voice.
Do set body copy in DM Sans Light, 16px, 150% line-height.
Do set numerals and tabular data (ownership shares, week counts, prices, dates) in DM Sans Mono.
Do reserve Gold (#FDB400) for accents — icons, dividers, highlights — never a primary button fill.
Do hold to the 20px / 40px spacing rhythm.
Do use the Heimkoma logo only at 128px / 64px / 32px, at its native proportions, unmodified.
donts: Don't use #1C3A5C navy or #C49A3A gold anywhere — this pairing (currently live in s1h1gb/, s1h2gb/, and thrif/) is drift from the authoritative #1F3D59 / #FDB400 / #113968 palette, not an alternate expression of it.

Don't use Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, or Inter — none are part of the brand system. DM Sans, DM Serif Display, and DM Sans Mono are the only approved families. (Cormorant Garamond is currently live in luxury-villa/ and passport/; Playfair Display + Inter in s1h1gb/ and s1h2gb/.)
Don't set DM Serif Display as a page's primary/top-level heading font, as thrif/ currently does — it is a secondary accent voice only, never the main driver.
Don't fill a primary button with Gold — Gold is accent-only; primary buttons are Navy Action with Off-white text.
Don't rotate, recolor, outline, distort, or redraw the Heimkoma logotype.
